plan.notes: Official 'Environmental Sciences' 4-year degree pathway from Central Washington University, 2026-2027 catalog (catoid=95, current); the same core map serves the Anthropology, Geography, Geology, and Policy specializations, with specialization courses chosen with faculty. All 12 quarters transcribed; every printed quarter total matches the transcribed credits (16/15/15/15/15/15/15/15/15/15/15/15; total 180). Credits verified against the 2026-2027 Acalog catalog where listed (ENST 201/202 = 5, ENST 300/303/360/400/460 = 5, ENST 461 = 4, ENST 487 = 1, SUST 301 = 4). ENST 495 (Senior Research) transcribed at 5 cr — it is a variable-credit (1-6 cr) research course; 5 cr makes the plan sum to the map's printed 180-credit degree total. Note the official road map is internally inconsistent by 1 credit: its printed quarter totals sum to 181 (Y1F = 16 plus eleven quarters at 15) while its printed degree total is 180. ENST 480 (Campus Sustainability) transcribed at 5 cr derived from the road map's printed Y4S quarter total (5+5+5 = 15); its catalog credit listing was not independently retrievable. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
